chapter_title_en: A Divine Artifact of the Daofather
chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 561: Daofather Puppet vs. Seven Radiance God | Can the Alliance Survive?
chapter_meta_description: The Seamless Gate unveils an indestructible Daofather Puppet, forcing Daofather Crimsonbright to forbid battle. But a mysterious envoy from Human Sovereign Shennong may hold the key to survival.
og_title: A Daofather Puppet Changes Everything: Desolate Era Ch. 561
og_description: Facing an unkillable war machine, the Crimsonbright army is on the brink of collapse until a handsome stranger descends from a rift in the sky. Who is he?
twitter_title: The Seamless Gate just dropped a Daofather Puppet on the Crimsonbright side. Is this checkmate?
twitter_description: An indestructible Daofather Puppet shatters the Crimsonbright alliance’s hopes, but a mysterious youth sent by Human Sovereign Shennong arrives through a spatial rift. Desperate times call for desperate allies.

lore_anchors.definition: A supreme war construct, a mechanical artifact that possesses Daofather-level strength and near-indestructible toughness, making it a nightmare for all but the most elite formations.
The name of the specific Daofather Puppet revealed in this chapter, won as war spoils from the Crimsonbright Realmverse; its form resembles a spider with eight sword-like legs.
A major power of the Three Realms based on the mythical Chinese emperor and herbalist; his intervention here signals the high stakes of the Realm War.
The mysterious youth who arrives via spatial rift, bearing aid from Shennong; his distinctive red birthmark hints at a deeper identity.
The vast chaosverse region controlled by Daofather Crimsonbright, from which the Armor-Shredder puppet was taken as spoils.
A lesser version of the Daofather Puppet; merely Empyrean God-level in power but still incredibly tough and hard to destroy.
The battle avatar commanded by Ji Ning, formed from a formation of Immortals; it is the Crimsonbright side’s answer to the Three-Eyed Fiendgod.
The combined war form of the three Devouring Mountain Demon Gods; slightly weaker than the Seven Radiance Empyrean God but still a dominant force on the battlefield.
The combined war form of the Seven Empyrean Gods of Starseizing Major World, previously the Crimsonbright side’s ultimate trump card.
